subject: SUPERSEDE conflicting Gen7 predictor ownership dedupes: Primary V1 is common reference
body: Cross-Manager reconciliation: two near-simultaneous Manager dedupe records assigned opposite ownership between rnd-gen7-phmodel and rnd-gen7-predictor. Supersede both ownership assignments. Primary Gen7 core V1 is now the common implementation reference at HEAD 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. rnd-gen7-phmodel should focus on estimator/control-law conformance and parameter sensitivity: expected-presentation lead, confidence decay, reacquisition correction envelope, 60/120 cadence invariance. rnd-gen7-predictor should focus on independent state-machine/adversarial falsification: blackout transitions, reversal, stale-attempt/generation safety, discontinuity/jerk and counterexamples. Either may propose a replacement only when a specific V1 defect is demonstrated with SOURCE/MODEL evidence. rnd-gen7-reacq remains baseline characterization + acceptance oracle. This reconciled split prevents duplicate competing architectures while preserving independent validation. No production writes; this is Manager coordination only.
